message: You know, I’ve always been a bit of a Boy Scout at heart—always prepared for whatever Mother Nature decides to throw our way. 🌪️ I stumbled upon this handy resource about tornadoes that’s perfect for anyone who wants to be gloriously over-prepared. It’s full of tips that help you understand what to do when the skies get a bit too dramatic. Have you ever found yourself in a stormy situation and wished you had a plan? I'd love to hear your stories!
